comment: Glyphh-hosted models (docs/specs/tokens.md), newest first. An id is adal-<size>-<major>-<minor>, lower case, with -beta for a beta. Rates are US cents per million tokens: the price on the page and the charge on the bill are the same number. allowance_weight is how much of a plan's monthly token allowance one token uses ((input + output) x weight). TBD (Chris): every rate and weight here is a placeholder until he sets it.
